cp9:1.1: Yā me ahosi janikā Phusatī nāma khattiyā sā atītāsu jātisu Sakkassa ca mahesiyā. || ||
cp9:2.1: Tassā āyukkhayaṃ disvā dev' indo etad-abravi: dadāmi te dasa vare vara bhadde yad-icchasi. || ||
cp9:3.1: Evaṃ vuttā ca sā devī Sakkaṃ pun' idam-abravi: kinnu me aparādh' atthi kinnu nu dessā ahaṃ tava, rammā cāvesi maṃ ṭhānā vāto va dharaṇīruhaṃ. || ||
cp9:4.1: Evaṃ vutto ca so Sakko puna tass' īdam-abravi: na c' eva te kataṃ pāpaṃ na ca me tvam-asi appiyā. || ||
cp9:5.1: Ettakaṃ-yeva te āyu cavanakālo bhavissati paṭiggaṇha mayā dinne vare dasa var' uttame. || ||
cp9:6.1: Sakkena sā dinnavarā tuṭṭhahaṭṭhā pamoditā mamaṃ abbhantaraṃ katvā Phusatī dasa vare varī. || ||
cp9:7.1: Tato cutā sā Phusatī khattiye upapajjatha Jetuttaramhi nagare Sañjayena samāgami. || ||
cp9:8.1: Yadāhaṃ Phusatiyā kucchiṃ okkanto piyamātuyā mama tejena me mātā sadā dānaratā ahu. || ||
cp9:9.1: Adhane āture jiṇṇe yācake addhike jane samaṇe brāhmaṇe khīṇe deti dānaṃ akiñcane. || ||
cp9:10.1: Dasa māse dhārayitvāna karonte purapadakkhiṇaṃ vessānaṃ vīthiyā majjhe janesi Phusatī mamaṃ. || ||
cp9:11.1: Na mayhaṃ mattikaṃ nāmaṃ na pi pettikasambhavaṃ jāt' ettha vessavīthiyā tasmā Vessantaro ahu. || ||
cp9:12.1: Yadā' haṃ dārako homi jātiyā aṭṭhavassiko tadā nisajja pāsāde dānaṃ dātuṃ vicintayiṃ. || ||
cp9:13.1: Hadayaṃ dadeyyaṃ cakkhuṃ maṃsam-pi ruhiram- pi ca dadeyyaṃ kāyaṃ sāvetvā yadi koci yācaye mamaṃ. || ||
cp9:14.1: Sabhāvaṃ cintayantassa akampitam-asaṇṭhitaṃ akampi tattha paṭhavī Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:15.1: Anvaddhamāse paṇṇarase puṇṇamāse uposathe Paccayaṃ nāgam-āruyha dānaṃ dātuṃ upāgamiṃ. || ||
cp9:16.1: Kāliṅgaraṭṭhavisayā brāhmaṇā upagañchu maṃ āyācuṃ maṃ hatthināgaṃ dhaññaṃ maṅgalasammataṃ: || ||
cp9:17.1: Avuṭṭhiko janapado {dubbhikkho} chātako mahā dadāhi pavaraṃ nāgaṃ sabbasetaṃ gaj' uttamaṃ. || ||
cp9:18.1: Dadāmi na vikampāmi yaṃ maṃ yācanti brāhmaṇā santaṃ nappatigūhāmi dāne me ramatī mano. || ||
cp9:19.1: Na me yācaka-m-anuppatte paṭikkhepo anucchavo mā me bhijji samādānaṃ dassāmi vipulaṃ gajaṃ. || ||
cp9:20.1: Nāgaṃ gahetvā soṇḍāya bhiṅkāre ratanāmaye jalaṃ hatthe ākiritvā brāhmaṇānaṃ adaṃ gajaṃ. || ||
cp9:21.1: Punāparaṃ dadantassa sabbasetaṃ gaj' uttamaṃ tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:22.1: Tassa nāgassa dānena Sivayo kuddhā samāgatā pabbājesuṃ sakā raṭṭhā: Vaṅkaṃ gacchatu pabbataṃ. || ||
cp9:23.1: Tesaṃ nicchubhamānānaṃ akampitam-asaṇṭhitaṃ mahādānaṃ pavattetuṃ ekaṃ varam-ayācissaṃ. || ||
cp9:24.1: Yācitā sivayo sabbe ekaṃ varam-adaṃsu me āsāvayitvā kaṇṇabheriṃ mahādānaṃ dadām' ahaṃ. || ||
cp9:25.1: Ath' ettha vattatī saddo tumulo bheravo mahā dānena maṃ nīharanti puna dānam dadām' ahaṃ. || ||
cp9:26.1: Hatthī asse rathe datvā dāsidāsaṃ gavaṃ dhanaṃ mahādānaṃ daditvāna nagarā nikkhamiṃ tadā. || ||
cp9:27.1: Nikkhamitvāna nagarā nivattitvā vilokite tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:28.1: Catuvāhiṃ rathaṃ datvā ṭhatvā cātummahāpathe ekākiyo adutiyo Maddideviṃ idam-abraviṃ: || ||
cp9:29.1: Tvaṃ Maddi Kaṇhaṃ gaṇhāhi lahukā esā kaniṭṭhakā ahaṃ Jāliṃ gahessāmi garuko bhātiko hi so. || ||
cp9:30.1: Padumaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ va Maddi Kaṇhājin' aggahī ahaṃ suvaṇṇabimbaṃ va Jāliṃ khattiyam-aggahiṃ. || ||
cp9:31.1: Abhijātā sukhumālā khattiyā caturo janā visamasamaṃ akkamantā Vaṅkaṃ gacchāma pabbataṃ. || ||
cp9:32.1: Ye keci manujā enti anumagge paṭippathe maggan-te paṭipucchāma: kuhiṃ Vaṅkatapabbato. || ||
cp9:33.1: Te tattha amhe passitvā karuṇaṃ giram-udīrayuṃ dukkhan-te paṭivedenti dūre Vaṅkatapabbato. || ||
cp9:34.1: Yadi passanti pavane dārakā phalite dume tesaṃ phalānaṃ hetumhi uparodanti dāraka. || ||
cp9:35.1: Rodante dārake disvā ubbiddhā vipulā dumā sayam-ev' onamitvāna upagacchanti dārake. || ||
cp9:36.1: Idaṃ acchariyaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ sādhukāraṃ pavattesi Maddī sabbaṅgasobhanā. || ||
cp9:37.1: Accheraṃ vata lokasmim abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ Vessantarassa tejena sayam-ev' onatā dumā. || ||
cp9:38.1: Saṅkhipiṃsu pathaṃ yakkhā anukampāya dārake nikkhantadivase- yeva Cetaraṭṭham-upāgamuṃ. || ||
cp9:39.1: Saṭṭhirājasahassāni tadā vasanti Mātule sabbe pañjalikā hutvā rodamānā upāgamuṃ. || ||
cp9:40.1: Tattha vattetvā sallāpaṃ Cetehi Cetaputtehi te tato nikkhamitvāna Vaṅkam-agamuṃ pabbataṃ. || ||
cp9:41.1: Āmantayitvā dev' indo Vissakammaṃ mah' iddhikaṃ: assamaṃ sukataṃ rammaṃ paṇṇasālaṃ sumāpaya. || ||
cp9:42.1: Sakkassa vacanaṃ sutvā Vissakammo mah' iddhiko assamaṃ sukataṃ rammaṃ paṇṇasālaṃ sumāpayi. || ||
cp9:43.1: Ajjhogāhetvā pavanaṃ appasaddaṃ nirākulaṃ caturo janā mayaṃ tattha vasāma pabbat' antare. || ||
cp9:44.1: Ahañca Maddidevī ca Jāli-Kaṇhājinā c' ubho aññamaññaṃ sokanudā vasāma assame tadā. || ||
cp9:45.1: Dārake anurakkhanto asuñño homi assame Maddī phalaṃ āharati, poseti sā tayo jane. || ||
cp9:46.1: Pavane vasamānassa addhiko maṃ upāgami āyāci puttake mayhaṃ Jāli-Kaṇhājinā c' ubho. || ||
cp9:47.1: Yācakaṃ upagataṃ disvā hāso me upapajjatha ubho putte gahetvāna adāsiṃ brāhmaṇe tadā. || ||
cp9:48.1: Sake putte cajantassa Jūjake brāhmaṇe yadā tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:49.1: Punad-eva Sakko oruyha hutvā brāhmaṇasannibho āyāci maṃ Maddideviṃ sīlavantiṃ patibbataṃ. || ||
cp9:50.1: Maddiṃ hatthe gahetvāna udakañjali pūriya pasannamanasaṅkappo tassa Maddim-adās' ahaṃ. || ||
cp9:51.1: Maddiyā dīyamānāyā gagane devā pamoditā; tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:52.1: Jāliṃ Kaṇhājinaṃ dhītaṃ Maddideviṃ patibbataṃ cajamāno na cintesiṃ bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā. || ||
cp9:53.1: Na me dessā ubho puttā Maddidevī na dessiyā sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā piye adās' ahaṃ. || ||
cp9:54.1: Punāparaṃ brahā' raññe mātāpitu samāgame karuṇaṃ paridevante sallapante sukhaṃ dukhaṃ, || ||
cp9:55.1: Hir' ottappena garunā ubhinnaṃ upasaṅkamiṃ, tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:56.1: Punāparaṃ brahā' raññā nikkhamitvā sañātibhi pavissāmi puraṃ rammaṃ Jetuttarapur' uttamaṃ. || ||
cp9:57.1: Ratanāni satta vassiṃsu mahāmegho pavassatha tadā pi paṭhavī kampi Sineruvanavaṭaṃsakā. || ||
cp9:58.1: Acetan' āyaṃ paṭhavī aviññāya sukhaṃ dukhaṃ sā pi dānabalā mayhaṃ sattakkhattuṃ pakampathā 'ti. || ||
